config.description: Balanced synthetic contextual benchmark with matched linear, neural, diagonal, greedy, and context-free policies.

method_semantics.cc_ucb_full_ggn_cg: Current-parameter relinearization of all selected historical samples, with one fixed matrix-free full-GGN operator per round and residual-checked CG for every candidate action.
method_semantics.diagonal_full_network_ucb: Local diagonal approximation to the full-network linearized UCB precision.
method_semantics.frozen_last_layer_ucb: The same frozen-representation Gaussian Bayesian linear posterior as neural_linear, with a UCB action rule.
method_semantics.full_network_update_budget: One clipped float64 SGD step per observed reward for cc_ucb_full_ggn_cg, neural_ucb, neural_ts, diagonal_full_network_ucb, and greedy_full_network.
method_semantics.neural_linear: Frozen initialized tanh representation with an exact Gaussian Bayesian linear posterior over the action-specific head; Thompson sampling uses a posterior draw.
method_semantics.neural_ts: Local full-network linearized Gaussian posterior-sampling implementation; not claimed to reproduce every detail of a published NeuralTS implementation.
method_semantics.neural_ucb: Local full-network linearized UCB implementation; not claimed to reproduce every detail of a published NeuralUCB implementation.

config.name: balanced_benchmark

sanity_check.criterion: lower mean cumulative pseudo-regret on the untouched evaluation seeds
